title: Build, run and test
summary: Needs Node 22 with npm i oorexxwasm, the oorexxwasm-web-0.2.4 release unpacked, ooDialog/WASM dist/, and for browser tests Python Playwright with Chromium. Build: rexx tools/build.rex RUNTIME_DIR OODIALOG_WASM_DIST OBJECT_EDITOR_DIR REXX_PARSER_DIR ESTATE_PACKAGES_DIR; serve: node site/serve.mjs site --port 8080; open /designer.html. build.rex also runs tools/plugins.rex (lays out site/plugins with their estate files), tools/data.rex (site/data: the mapped-objects closure, People.cls, the ent database) and tools/database.rex (ChatGPT). Tests: REXX_PATH=src:tests:vendor ESTATE_PACKAGES=ALCHEMY/packages rexx tests/run_all.rex . runs t01-t10 each in its own process; tools/dztest.py drives the page (22 scenarios at v0.17, on ooDialog/WASM v0.23.0: resize stretches a list and moves a button by exactly the 120x80 px the running dialog grew; newkinds the up-down, month calendar and tip run end to end; labdrag the drag-to-connect on the real model; catch the CATCH/FINALLY graph and the run refusal; bound covers the picker, Remove, Add and row fields; overview the closed tree, marks and All code; labgraph the Database Lab graph and the bound design's object lines); the Object Editor has oxtest.py (12 at v0.4: assist also documents a member; libdocs the Libraries panel docs). t07-t09 start stand-in servers (tests/fixtures/*_mock_server.mjs). ChatGPT's tests/database_lab_dom.cjs needs jsdom 27 (npm install --no-save jsdom@27). Windows checks for CODEX-PC (testing only, Tom's approval): tests/wincheck.rex wincheck.files (31 checks, ooDialog) and tests/catchcheck.rex (CATCH on r13514+; FINALLY only with the argument FINALLY); brief REQ-00004977. ChatGPT's tests/database_lab_chromium.cjs needs node playwright and starts /usr/bin/chromium (link it to Playwright's Chromium). CODEX-PC is a Linux host (ooRexx r13196, 2026-11-15): it cannot run wincheck.rex; Windows ooDialog checks need Tom's own Windows machine. Linux Qt6 renderer (v0.18): build ooRexx from github.com/ooRexx/ooRexx (cmake, make install to a prefix), Qt 6 from apt (qt6-base-dev), oodialog-qt6 per its README (cmake -S native -B build -DOOREXX_PREFIX=...), then rexx tools/oodqt_test.rex DESIGNER/tests/qt/NewKinds.rex Resizer.rex Catcher.rex and tests/gen/*.rex, offscreen and under xvfb-run with --platform xcb. In tests/qt steps, +N in resize is from marklayout, not mark. v0.20: rexx tools/selftest.rex (from the designer's folder) sets REXX_PATH with .File~pathSeparator and runs run_all and catchcheck. run_all sets the directory and REXX_PATH from Rexx, not with 'cd ... && VAR=... rexx', so it runs under Windows cmd; there it skips t07-t09 (their stand-in servers need a POSIX shell). run_all, t04 and t06-t09 take a folder whose path holds blanks (test names are taken from the end).
procedure: Run the Boston Crab pitfall lint (oorexx_slam_bostoncrab v0.24 tests/rexx_pitfalls.rex) on src, plugins and tests: it must be clean.
Run run_all.rex, dztest.py and oxtest.py; all green before a package.
Make the package with rexx tools/mkpkg.rex PREVIOUS_PACKAGE_DIR NEW_VERSION (it ends with pkgcheck, which must PASS) before alchemy_submit.

Package as packages/oorexx_oodialog_designer_vX with integration.json (alchemy.autobuild.integration/0.3, paths as ${REPO_ROOT}/packages/...), then: python3 tools/alchemy_submit.py --repo . --package DIR --submitted-by CLAUDE --json
Update this sphere (articles, CHANGELOG, MANIFEST, validate) in the same change as the package.
Autobuild runs native ooRexx (no ADDRESS FETCH): network checks must SKIP, not fail.
invariants: REXX_PATH must be set before ooRexx starts, which is why tools/make.sh and test.sh are shell lines.
A failed plugin layout fails the tests; it is never silently skipped when ESTATE_PACKAGES is set.
Build against the current oodialog-wasm branch (OOD_DIST=its dist/ in tools/make.sh) and say which commit; designer v0.8-v0.15 were built on ooDialog/WASM v0.7.0.

tools/make.sh builds the site from ooDialog/WASM /home/claude/src/oodwasm/oodialog-wasm/dist (v0.27) and the Rexx Parser 20261115 by default (v0.22). Before, its defaults were a stale ooDialog/WASM copy and parser 20261105, and newkinds, resize, graph, trace, assist and catch failed. Check site/rexx-parser/VERSION after a build.
